changes: original_meaning 按拉丁语 segmentum 的 gloss 收为「切下的一片，一条」。
semantic_path 第二站 how 按 Etymonline 编年（1560 年代几何术语 → 1640 年代圆形分段 → 1762 年泛指部分）写明泛化过程，替换套话。
mechanism_sentence 重写，并点明它与 section 同源（secare）。
evidence: Etymonline: "segment (n.) 1560s, in geometry, \"plane figure contained by a right angle and a part of a circumference of a circle,\" from Latin segmentum \"a strip or piece cut off, a cutting, strips of colored cloth,\" from secare \"to cut\"... Latin segmentum was used in Medieval Latin as a geometry term, translating Greek tmema. The meaning \"segmental portion of anything circular\" is from 1640s; the general sense of \"a division, section, part cut off or marked as separate from others\" is from 1762."
Oxford: "late 16th cent. (as a term in geometry): from Latin segmentum, from secare 'to cut'."
segment.mechanism_sentence: segment 与 section 是同根兄弟（都出自拉丁语 secare「切」）：1560 年代它先作几何术语入场，1762 年起泛指切分出的任何部分——连橙子的一瓣也归它管。

semantic_path.how: 从术语走向日常（词义扩大）：1560 年代入英语时是几何学的弓形，1640 年代扩到一切圆形之物的分段，1762 年泛化为『切下或单独划出的任何一部分』——词库『部分；（水果的）瓣』即此，正是拿刀分橙子的画面。

changes: original_meaning 按古法语 seisir 的 gloss 记录为「（凭权力）占有，取得」（原是封建法律词）；更深层的日耳曼来源未定，disputes 已登记，不写入路径。
semantic_path 按 Etymonline 编年重建三站（13 世纪中法律占有 → 约 1300 年抓握 → 14 世纪末疾病/恐惧袭人），how 写明由抽象到具体再及比喻的少见走向。
evidence: Etymonline: "seize (v.) mid-13c., seisen, \"take possession, take possession of\" (land, goods, etc.) by force or authority, from Old French seisir \"to take possession of, take by force; put in possession of, bestow upon\"... Originally a legal term in reference to feudal property holdings or offices. Meaning \"to grip with the hands or teeth\" is from c. 1300; that of \"to take possession by force or capture\" (of a city, etc.) is from mid-14c. Figurative use, with reference to death, disease, fear, etc., \"to come upon with a sudden attack,\" is from late 14c."
Oxford: "from Old French seizir 'give seisin (possession of land)', from medieval Latin sacire, in the phrase ad proprium sacire 'claim as one's own'"
seize.mechanism_sentence: seize 本是封建法律词——「凭权力占有土地、授予职位」：约 1300 年，它从文书落到手上，成了「抓住、夺取」；再后来，连疾病和恐惧也会「一把攫住」人了。

semantic_path.how: 抽象的占有落到身体上：约 1300 年 seize 添『用手或牙紧紧抓住』义，14 世纪中添『武力夺取（城市等）』义——从法律文书里的归属，变成实实在在的攫取；词库『抓住；夺取』即此。
抓住的主体换了：14 世纪末起，疾病、死亡、恐惧成了 seize 的主语——『（病、恐惧）突然袭来、一把攫住人』（比喻引申）；1855 年又添『心智领会』义。

changes: original_meaning 保留古英语 seldan 的见载义「很少，不常」。
semantic_path 第二站 how 写明词形被类推改变（seldan → seldum）的史实与年代（Etymonline）；词基本义『稀罕』及与 self 或有关的推测只放在 mechanism_sentence 并标注来源口径，不冒充定论。
mechanism_sentence 重写（原句为罗列式）。
evidence: Etymonline: "seldom (adv.) \"rarely, not often, infrequently,\" late Old English and early Middle English seldum, an alteration of seldan \"infrequently, rarely,\" from Proto-Germanic *selda- \"strange, rare\"... a word of uncertain etymology. Perhaps ultimately from the base of self. The form shifted apparently on analogy of adverbial dative plurals in -um (as in whilom \"at one time\")"
Etymonline: "The forms in -n decreased from 14c. and faded out in 16c."
Oxford: "Old English seldan, of Germanic origin; related to Dutch zelden and German selten, from a base meaning 'strange, wonderful'."
seldom.mechanism_sentence: seldom 的词基带着「稀罕」味（牛津：源于意为『奇异、罕见』的词基，或与 self 有关，此处来源只作推测）：词义千年未变，倒是词尾在中古被 whilom 一类副词带跑，seldan 变成了 seldom。

semantic_path.how: 义守恒、形有变：古英语晚期 seldan 被副词与格复数的 -um 词尾类推带成 seldum（whilom 同理），带 -n 的旧形 14 世纪起衰减、16 世纪退出——今天的 seldom 是这样定型的（Etymonline 编年）。
semantic_path.meaning: 很少，不常（词形定型为 seldom）

changes: original_meaning 按古英语 self 的 gloss 收为「自己本人」（形容词性的『自己的；同一的』在 how/机制句中交代）。
semantic_path 第二站 how 补名词化的确切起点（约 1200 年）与 14 世纪初『自我』义，替换套话。
evidence: Etymonline: "self (pron., n., adj.) Old English self, sylf (West Saxon), seolf (Anglian), \"one's own person, -self; own, personal; same, identical,\" from Proto-Germanic *selbaz"

Etymonline: "Its use as the second element in compounded reflexive pronouns (herself, etc.) was in Old English... As a noun from c. 1200 as \"the person or thing previously specified;\" early 14c. as \"a person in relation to that same person.""
Oxford: "Early use was emphatic, expressing the sense '(I) myself', '(he) himself', etc."
self.mechanism_sentence: self 在古英语里是跟在人称后面的强调词（ic selfa——「我自己」）：约 1200 年起它单独立户当名词，从「本人」长成了心理学、哲学里的那个「自我」。

semantic_path.how: 小词立户（词类转换）：约 1200 年 self 用作名词，指『所说的那个人、那件物本身』；14 世纪初添『相对于自身的那个人格』义——由此长成词库今义『自我』，myself、yourself 中那个 -self 仍守着古英语的老用法（附在人称代词后强调）。
